anime_multiverse.spiritlight.say.spiritl: Peace be with you. I am here.
The light remembers you. I rise at your side.
Be not afraid. I am your light.
I answer. Walk, and I will go before you.
Rest now. I will keep the light for you.
Until you call me again, be well.
I return to the light. Peace.
Behold. The light takes its true form.
Many eyes open, that you may not be alone.
Stand firm. The heavens are with you.
The vision fades. I am still near.
I fold my wings, but I do not leave.
Let the light go forth.
Be pierced by the truth.
A ray of mercy, swift and straight.
Light, strike true.
Nothing hidden can stand before it.
Nothing hides from the light.
Let every shadow be known.
I see them. Now, so do you.
Be revealed.
I am hurt, but I endure.
The light flickers, yet it does not fail.
Do not mind me. Keep your eyes forward.
Ah... this pain is a small thing.
Your strength is failing. Hold on, I am with you.
Do not yield. The light is not done with you.
Breathe. Step back, and breathe.
Well done. The dark gives way.
Justice is done. Rejoice, but gently.
The light prevails.
No... not yet. Rise again, my friend.
Sleep, bright one. The light will find you.
All is calm. The light is with us.
Walk on. I am watching the way.
